newsitem.title: USA: Norrell files for share offer.
newsitem.headline: Norrell files for share offer.

text.p: Norrell Corp filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register up to 2.85 million common shares of which it will offer 2.5 million shares and a group of shareholders will sell 350,000 shares.
Underwriters for the offering, Dillon Read & Co Inc, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and the Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc, have an over-allotment option of 427,500 shares.
The Atlanta-based company that provides staffing services said it will use the proceeds from the sale to repay outstanding debt.
After the offering, the company will have 26,553,484 common shares outstanding, according to the SEC filing.
